instructions: The specs for this repository live in a spec hub, not here. The pull request description links the hub change folder espec/changes/<change-name>/. Its tech-proposal.md, delta specs under specs/, tasks.md and pull-request.md are the intended behaviour. When the reviewer pastes or attaches them, read them before explaining code.
Order the tour by the How to review section of the pull request description when it exists: entry points, then the core, then tests.
Flag code that differs from the tech proposal or the delta specs without a matching row in the Proposal versus implementation table of the pull request description.
Flag behaviour changes that no acceptance criterion (AC-n) or delta spec scenario describes, and acceptance criteria whose Verified by test is missing from the diff.
Flag changes to an interface other repositories consume that the tech proposal does not list with its versioning and release order.
